papers.summary_en: AI agents in containers act by opening network connections, and the text that drives them can be hostile. Controls placed between the agent and its tools are bypassed by a child process or a direct socket, and their approval is not tied to the connection the kernel later opens. We present connection escrow: every outbound TCP connection from a supervised pod is parked inside the kernel's connect() path, before any packet exists, by a 98-instruction eBPF program on the pod's cgroup. ABSTRACT
In the contemporary landscape of 2026, the exponential proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices within academic and corporate infrastructures has introduced a critical surface for cyber-attacks. Traditional security paradigms, which rely on perimeter-based defenses and reactive patching, are increasingly inadequate against sophisticated firmware-level threats such as hardcoded credentials, hidden backdoors, and insecure binary configurations. news.title: LWN.net Weekly Edition for October 15, 2026
news.abstract: Welcome to the LWN.net Weekly Edition for October 15, 2026 This edition contains the following feature content: The 2026 Maintainers Summit : a writeup of topics discussed at the yearly, invite-only, gathering of kernel maintainers. An update on Rust's project goals : an inside view of the process of making changes to Rust. GCC development with large-language models : GCC's LLM policy is restrictive of LLM-generated code, but contributors are still using them for bug-hunting, research, and more. Adding kernel control-flow-integrity checking to GCC : Kees Cook explains changes to GCC to help prevent one form of kernel exploits. The state of systemd: 2026 edition : how the project is coping with LLMs, and some of the major new features added in the last year. Owning C types from Rust code : a look at work to provide a Rust trait for objects allocated in C. Collaborating with out-of-tree tracers : the frustrating catch-22 keeping the LTTng tracing framework from inclusion in the mainline kernel. news.summary: 这是一期LWN.net内核开发周报，汇总维护者峰会、Rust for Linux项目目标与C类型所有权、LLM辅助GCC开发、控制流完整性检查、systemd现状、out-of-tree追踪器合并及swap方案等专题。文章主要采用会议记录、项目进展分析和开发策略讨论的方法，没有给出网络子系统的具体补丁、性能测试或评估结论，也未明确涉及eBPF/XDP、网卡驱动、容器网络数据面、DPDK或RDMA，因而与目标高速网络技术路径关联很弱。
